verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸ ਨ ਛਡੈ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਛਪੜ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ha(n)s na chhaddai maanasar bagulaa bahu chhapaR fir aavai|

en.bdb: The swan never leaves Manasarovar, the sacred tank, but the crane always comes to the dirty pond.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਬ ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਕਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: koil bolai a(n)b van van van kaau kuthaau sukhaavai|

en.bdb: The nightingale sings in the mango groves but the crow feels comfort at an abominable place in the forest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਗ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕੁਤੀਆਂ ਗਾਈਂ ਗੋਰਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: vag na hovan kuteeaa(n) gaiee(n) goras va(n)s vadhaavai|

en.bdb: The female dogs have no groups. (like cows) and the cows only give milk and increase their lineage.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਬਿਰਖ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਣਸ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: safal birakh nihachal matee nihafal maanas dheh dhis dhaavai|

en.bdb: The tree full of fruits is stable at one place whereas a vain person always runs here and there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿ ਤਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਸੀਅਲਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨੀਵਾਂ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ag tatee jal seealaa sir uchaa neevaa(n) dhikhalaavai|

en.bdb: The fire is full of heat (of ego) and keeps its head high but the water being cold always goes downward.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aap gavaiaa manmukh moorakh aap ganaavai|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh divests his soul of ego but the manmukh, the fool always counts himself (above all).
Having sense of duality is not a good conduct, and one always is defeated.
